question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

In the same boat
solution:
The correct answer is** 'In a similar situation'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'In the same boat' **is** 'In a similar situation'.**
 
• **In the same boat:** be in the same difficult circumstances as others. (दूसरों के समान कठिन परिस्थितियों में रहें)
 
 
• *Example: Do not despair: you are one of the millions** in the same boat.***

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *In a similar situation.*
